findings.desc: quality-tautology: review-run-metadataroot-wrapper-root-smoke.ts:394-400 Proof C is tautological — both `fallback` and `explicit` call checkEvidenceFreshnessForGit with identical arguments (root, root), so deepEqual always passes and the assertion does not actually exercise the legacy-fallback path through the consumer code (run.workspaceBinding?.metadataRoot ?? projectRoot). The test is supposed to verify that a ReviewRun with no workspaceBinding falls back to projectRoot, but it never constructs such a run or calls assertCurrentReviewRunForEvidence; it only compares a function with itself.

CHK-004:edge:0 intent says signReviewRun + workspaceBinding signatures byte-identical for the default/plain-repo case (guard asserts), but Proof D only exercises captureReviewRunSnapshot and checkEvidenceFreshnessForGit byte-identity. signReviewRun and buildReviewRunWorkspaceBinding are not called in Proof D. The property holds transitively but the smoke does not directly guard-assert signing byte-identity as the intent claims. Evidence pointer is mislabeled for this specific claim.

Missing coverage for validateEvidenceRunBinding consumer. The B-9dcb diff changes both assertCurrentReviewRunForEvidence and validateEvidenceRunBinding to pass run.workspaceBinding?.metadataRoot ?? projectRoot into checkEvidenceFreshnessForGit, but packages/main/src/tasks/review-run-metadataroot-wrapper-root-smoke.ts only exercises assertCurrentReviewRunForEvidence plus raw checkEvidenceFreshnessForGit calls. rg found no collectReviewerEvidenceState/validateEvidenceRunBinding coverage in the new smoke, and npm --prefix packages/main run test:review-run-metadataroot-wrapper-root still passes; a regression in the collectReviewerEvidenceState path would be undetected. Add an end-to-end reviewer pass/finding record and collectReviewerEvidenceState assertion over the wrapper-root custom-storyDir metadata-only churn fixture.
findings.resolvedReason: Added collectReviewerEvidenceState coverage to the wrapper-root custom-storyDir metadataRoot smoke. The persisted signed review pass now reaches validateEvidenceRunBinding through the real reviewer evidence consumer and remains valid after custom storyDir metadata-only churn. Verified with npm --prefix packages/main run build and npm --prefix packages/main run test:review-run-metadataroot-wrapper-root.
